title: Find Your Way
description: Go and see Dorrin Saltmarsh, the Provisioner.

giver.name: Hollis Barrowmead
giver.text: Next, you'll want to know where you are. An old sailor named Dorrin Saltmarsh keeps Saltmarsh Provisions, on the east side of the square. Torches, rods, rope and maps, and a better teacher of the compass than I am.

rewards.hint: Right-click the world map to drop a waypoint. /wp add works too.
